name: @flow/root
description: Approval-safe AI booking automation with deterministic deal optimization.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @flow/api && npm run build --workspace @flow/worker && npm run build --workspace @flow/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @flow/contracts && npm run build --workspace @flow/config && npm run build --workspace @flow/core && npm run build --workspace @flow/db && npm run build --workspace @flow/providers && npm run build --workspace @flow/ai && npm run build --workspace @flow/runtime
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @flow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @flow/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @flow/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @flow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @flow/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @flow/web && tsc --noEmit -p integrations/bms-bot/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
